verdict.strongest_covered_cluster: The live-turn operational path is exceptionally complete: web/mobile entry, both safety screens, profile/transcript/article context assembly, model generation, safe fallback, credentialed billing/account actions, and fully specified human handoff are all represented with explicit components, labels, and directed edges.
verdict.most_consequential_gap: R26 is only partial: the board clearly shows configuration-driven loading and champion swapping, but it never explicitly states the operational constraint that rollout occurs without redeploying the service.
verdict.coverage_summary: The board represents nearly the entire stated contract across live assistance, durable memory and retention, champion/challenger experimentation, human-gated promotion and rollback, and independent regression control. The only substantive qualifier gap is the omitted no-redeployment statement for configuration rollouts; the permitted challenger variation examples in R23 are also not enumerated. Weighted coverage is 0.9783, with no absent or contradicted system-defining requirement and therefore no cap.
